# Matthieu Queloz — publications site

This site contains a portfolio of academic philosophy publications with abstracts and (when available) PDF links.

Canonical base URL: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/

Languages:
- English: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/
- Français: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/fr/
- Deutsch: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/de/

Key indexes:
- Sitemap (all pages): https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/sitemap.xml
- Search index (JSON): https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/search.json
- Tags: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/tags/
- Categories: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/categories/

Core sections (English):
- Theoretical philosophy: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/theoretical-philosophy/
- Practical philosophy: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/practical-philosophy/
- History of philosophy: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/history-of-philosophy/
- Media / outreach: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/media/
- Bibliography: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/bibliography/
- Books: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/books/

Core sections (Français):

- Philosophie pratique: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/fr/practical-philosophy/

Core sections (Deutsch):

Where to find publications:
- Individual entries are under: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/entries/
- Language-specific entries are under: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/fr/entries/ and https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/de/entries/

Metadata:
- Entry pages include machine-readable citation meta tags and schema.org JSON-LD (ScholarlyArticle).
- Crawlable LLM hub (HTML): https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/llm/papers/
- Paper-selection index (Markdown): https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/llm/papers/index.md
- Paper-selection index (JSON): https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/llm/papers/index.json
- LLM-layer sitemap: https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/llm/papers/sitemap.xml
- Some works also include machine-readable text companions under https://www.matthieuqueloz.com/llm/papers/

How to use the LLM layer:
- Use the HTML or JSON/Markdown indexes to identify relevant works by title, abstract, tags, categories, and year.
- Use the canonical entry URL for citation metadata and the published PDF.
- When a companion full text exists, prefer `.../llm/papers/<slug>.md` for structured reading and `.../llm/papers/<slug>.txt` when plain text is preferable.
- Companion full texts preserve section headings and printed page markers such as `[p. 12]` where available.
- `robots.txt` is configured to allow current AI search, user-retrieval, and model-training crawlers.
